locator.text: Display 97.3, p. 97, in the proof of Lemma 8.7

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Stated in general form, though in the outgoing-pulse files rather than the Lemma 8.7 ones. `power_bump_integral_scale` (OutgoingPulseBounds.lean:543) says, for every real a, every k > 0 and every 0 < l < u, ∫ t^a·bump(kl,ku)(t) dt = k^{a+1}·∫ t^a·bump(l,u)(t) dt, and `bump_scale` (:452) identifies bump(kl,ku) with the dilate η_0(·/k) of the single template η_0 = `radialTemplate` (:411), a nonnegative bump supported in (e^{-3/20}, e^{3/20}), the paper's η_0 near x₀ = 1 > 0. The rewriting to the display is exactly the paper's amplitude normalisation: the paper writes η_j = a_j^{-1}η_0(·/a_j), so ∫ x^p η_j dx = a_j^{-1}·a_j^{p+1}μ_p = μ_p a_j^p = μ_p e^{jdp}, which is Lean's k^{a+1} divided by the k the paper puts in the amplitude. μ_p itself is `rowMoment a = ∫ x^a radialTemplate x` (:493), defined for arbitrary real a. At geometric centers the display is stated literally: `lower_scale`/`upper_scale` (:465, :473) give the cells as e^{center j}·(templateLower, templateUpper) with center j in arithmetic progression of step 2 — the paper's a_j = e^{jd}, d = 2 — and `actual_matrix_entry` (:565) states ∫ x^{p_i} η_j = μ_{p_i} e^{(p_i+1)c_j}. In log coordinates `AngularMomentReset.bump_moment` (:97) is the display verbatim for the translated family bump j y = template(y − 2j) (:24, :26), with `weighted_translate_integral` (:542) the general translate form. The positivity half: `AngularMomentReset.moment_pos` (:88) gives 0 < moment s for every real s; in the radial variable `rowMoment_pos` (:598) gives μ_p > 0 only for the two exponents of that instance, since `rowMoment_bounds` (:509) assumes −1 ≤ p ≤ 0, so general-p positivity of `rowMoment` is an unstated instance of the same three-line argument (nonnegative, continuous, nonzero at the center). What differs is scope and use, not content: the instantiated family there has two members (Fin 2), not the paper's j = 0,1,2, though the scaling lemma is for arbitrary k so it covers j = 2 as well; and this machinery serves the outgoing-pulse repair, not Lemma 8.7. The Lemma 8.7 pipeline (FiveRowRank / LocalizedMomentRepair / FiveProfileMoments) never invokes the product formula: its profiles are bumps on pairwise disjoint cells of the patch (`FiveRowRank.cellLower`/`cellUpper`), their moments stay as unevaluated integrals (`FiveProfileMoments.bumpMoment`, :151), and the invertibility this display serves is obtained there from `PowerMomentMatrix.intervalMomentMatrix_det_ne_zero` (:216) instead. That route difference is recorded under eq-p098-1; the identity itself is in the repository.
